title: Connectivity diagnostics and reachability messaging for Luxeoushub storefront

requirements.summary: Show a public storefront connectivity error state when the backend is unreachable, with Retry and current URL display.
acceptanceCriteria: When backend actor calls fail due to network/unreachable errors, the Home page renders a visible, non-technical English error banner/section instead of silently failing.
The error UI includes a Retry button that re-attempts the failed query/queries.
The error UI displays the current URL so the site owner can confirm/copy what they are sharing.
When the backend is reachable again, the error UI disappears and normal storefront sections render.

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight React Query hook that calls the backend health-check capability (e.g., actor.healthCheck) to distinguish “reachable” vs “unreachable”, and exposes status + a refetch function for the UI to drive a Retry action. Leverage the existing core-infrastructure actor creation via useActor. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Enhance the storefront products query to surface error state (e.g., isError/error) and a refetch function to support a user-initiated Retry from the Home page when product loading fails due to reachability issues.

Add a public-facing connectivity error banner/section above the storefront content that appears when the backend health-check and/or initial product fetch fails, includes a clear English message, displays the current page URL (window.location.origin and window.location.href), and provides a Retry button that triggers refetch of health + product queries. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the Retry action (compose only; do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an English troubleshooting checklist to the custom domain/publishing documentation for “This site can’t be reached”.
acceptanceCriteria: The documentation file frontend/docs/custom-domain-luxeoushub.com.md contains actionable steps for verifying DNS and domain mapping and a troubleshooting checklist for “This site can’t be reached”.
The troubleshooting section includes guidance to test reachability using the platform-provided live URL before testing the custom domain.
All added documentation text is written in English.

file_operations.description: Extend the document with a dedicated troubleshooting section for the browser error “This site can’t be reached”, including an actionable checklist to verify DNS records, platform domain mapping, and explicit steps to confirm a working live URL by first testing the platform-provided URL and then the custom domain once configured (all text in English).
